_comment: sim/cmrr-psrr systematic CMRR as ONE `klt sim` measurement (issue #505): cmrr_db = Av0 - Acm0 in dB, same construction as psrr_direct.request.json.

Circuit: tb_cmrr_direct.body.spice -- two independent copies of the DUT in one deck. Copy A (Vinp ac 1 differential, Vdd quiet) gives Av0; copy B (in-phase common-mode source Vcmb ac 1 reaching inp directly and inn through Ccm, supply quiet) gives Acm. They share only quiet reference nodes, so one AC solve is exactly the two single-excitation solves.

Grid, models, cap/res sections, analysis and options are byte-identical to psrr_direct.request.json (45 corners; DR-1, DR-0012, DR-0005), so Av0 comes from the same DUT, corner, temperature, VDD and .options as the PSRR direct deck's Av0.

cmrr_db is a derived expr measurement read at the first AC point (10 mHz DC shelf); it stays dB, Av0 - Acm0 (positive). No limits: the systematic-floor row is superseded by DR-4 (context only; bound 30.75 dB is applied by the offline report from selection.json).
cmrr_plateau_delta_db is the direct form of the flat-shelf guard: |CMRR(0.1 Hz) - CMRR(10 mHz)| <= 0.05 dB (dec-20 grid: index 20 is 0.1 Hz). A miss is a result, not hidden.
av0_db and acm0_db are the two operands read separately, ungraded, so the offline cross-check can compare each with the committed harness record.
keep_artifacts is false so the committed envelope carries no host-absolute artifact paths.
remote.hosts 5: klt shards the 45-unit job into five jobs (one per process corner).
